content:
Elena (Sales): quick handoff — Parity Health signed yesterday, 6mo pilot then potential org-wide rollout. Dedicated plan requested (likely private), SSO + SCIM required, and they want embeddings for semantic search. Renewal window looks around 10 months out but procurement needs budget signoff in 3 weeks. asking cs to own enablement + support triage.
Ben (CS): thanks Elena. can you drop the contract link and the prod contact? also any perf expectations?
Elena (Sales): link: https://redwood.example/contracts/PRTY-2026 (internal). Prod contact is Maya Li (mli@parityhealth.com). they run ~40 reqs/s peak and care about 95th p95 < 200ms for chat.
Aisha (Enablement): noted. I'll draft onboarding playbook + 2 training sessions. suggested timeline: kickoff next Tue, infra checklist (SSO, network allowlist, prov tokens) before kick.
Priya (SolutionsEng): pinging on embeddings: what index size / #docs? and are they fine with hosted vector DB or need private?
Elena (Sales): ~500k docs initially. they prefer private embeddings store in their VPC, but open to guidance.
Tom (Support): tagging for CS->support handoff: we'll need runbook for token rotation, metrics alerts, escalation path to eng. assigning a primary oncall for first 30 days.
Ben (CS): action list from this thread: 1) Aisha — onboarding playbook + kickoff slides (owner: Aisha) 2) Priya — recommend embeddings architecture and cost estimate (owner: Priya) 3) Tom — create support runbook & initial alerting thresholds (owner: Tom) 4) Ben — schedule kickoff, share customer context doc and success criteria (owner: Ben) 5) Elena — intro email to Maya + attach contract and SSO details (owner: Elena). will follow up with dates. :thumbsup:
Aisha (Enablement): ok I'll prepare a lightweight checklist and a 45min enablement session template. putting key items: SSO (Okta), SCIM preview, private VPC peering, KMS/HSM for keys, sample env vars + test curl.
Priya (SolutionsEng): for embeddings — preliminary rec: quantized ada-like embeddings, host in customer's VPC, use batch ingestion + incremental updates. rough cost ballpark: $900–1.2k/month for 500k docs after indexing (depends on vector db). will send a short doc by EOD.
Tom (Support): runbook outline: incident severity matrix, contact matrix, token rotation steps, quick repro checklist. I'll add concrete alert thresholds: error rate > 1% sustained for 5m, token latency p95 > 500ms for 3m.
Elena (Sales): procurement note — Parity legal asked about DATA_PROCESSING_ADDENDUM and SOC2 docs. ops team, can we attach SOC2 link & DPA template in the intro?
OpsBot: SOC2 report (redacted) available at https://redwood.example/compliance/soc2. DPA template sent to Elena as draft.
Ben (CS): timeline proposal: Kickoff 2026-04-07, SSO & network config complete by 2026-04-14, enablement sessions 2026-04-15 and 2026-04-22, private deployment validation week 2026-04-26. if that works I'll block calendar and send invites.
Aisha (Enablement): works for me. I'll add pre-kickoff checklist to the calendar invite.
Priya (SolutionsEng): I'll aim to post embedding recommendation doc by EOD tomorrow and schedule a short tech deep-dive for 2026-04-08.
Tom (Support): assigning primary: @tom-support oncall for first 30 days, backup @ben-cs. adding to runbook.
Elena (Sales): i'll send intro + attach SOC2/DPA + contract. Maya's timezone PST. will cc ops and cs.
Ben (CS): thanks all — tagging owners again: @Aisha (playbook), @Priya (embeddings), @Tom (runbook), @Elena (intro/contract). i'll update the tracking sheet after kickoff invite. :rocket:
Priya (SolutionsEng): quick Q — are we planning canary traffic or straight cutover for private deploy?
Ben (CS): prefer canary 10% for 48h then ramp if stable. note in runbook.
Elena (Sales): procurement also requested estimated spend report for first 12 months. finance ask — Ben can you coordinate?
Ben (CS): yep will generate and share by end of week.
OpsBot: reminder: create tracking ticket in #onboarding-tracker with ID auto-assigned.
Ben (CS): created ticket ONB-4721 and linked contract. I'll paste the ticket link in a follow-up.
Aisha (Enablement): one more: capture feedback loop — we'll send a 2-week and 6-week survey to gauge success metrics (time-to-first-successful-call, latencies, false-positive reranks).
Elena (Sales): perfect. closing the handoff here — will post the intro email and contract link when sent. reach out in this thread for any blockers. :handshake:
